AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY MANAGER'S OFFICE

  FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING
  THURSDAY OCTOBER 7, 2021
  6:00 P.M.

Meeting Location: City Hall Executive Conference Room, 21815 Pioneer Blvd.,
Hawaiian Gardens, CA 90716. ALL MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WHO ATTEND THE
FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETINGS ARE REQUIRED TO WEAR A FACE MASK/FACE
SHIELD AT ALL TIMES AND PRACTICE SOCIAL DISTANCING.

Please Note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the Americans
with Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please contact the
Community Development Department at (562) 420-2641 ext. 236, at least one business
day prior to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

A.  COMMITTEE MEMBERS

    Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
    Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
    Luis Roa, Mayor, Chair
    Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem

B.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  This is the time reserved for those in the audience to address the Committee
  regarding any subject that may pertain to this Committee's subject matter. (Time
  Limit: Maximum of three (3) minutes per speaker; total time allocated is 10
  minutes.)

C.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

  1. Pension Obligation Bonds Update
  2. Audit Schedules
  3. Budget Workshop

D.  NEW BUSINESS

E.  ADJOURNMENT

  Adjourn to the next meeting as determined by the Committee members.
